description: Evidence-backed negative result for i015 (SNAPSHOT=s04, BRANCH=vhost-virtio-guestmem). Searched s04's drivers/vhost (vhost.c, vringh.c, net.c, scsi.c, vsock.c, test.c, vdpa.c), drivers/vdpa/vdpa_sim, and drivers/vdpa/vdpa_user for check-then-use double fetches on guest-writable shared memory. No finding: every candidate satisfies the single-fetch invariant. Concrete evidence per candidate (12 total, 11 safe, 1 unresolved): (1) drivers/vhost/vhost.c:2290 - each vring descriptor fetched ONCE into stack 'struct vring_desc desc' via vhost_get_desc()->vhost_copy_from_user (vhost.c:1042-1046); next_desc() reads desc->next from the stack copy (vhost.c:2107), chained index re-validated i >= vq->num each iteration (vhost.c:2276-2281), desc.addr/desc.len consumed by translate_desc from the same copy. (2) vhost.c:2255 avail head fetched once into local ring_head, bounds-checked head >= vq->num (vhost.c:2264). (3) vhost.c:2119 get_indirect len from caller's stack copy; sanity check and consuming translate_desc (vhost.c:2132) share one copy. (4) drivers/vhost/vringh.c:322 __vringh_iov (backing vringh_getdesc_user/_kern/_iotlb used by vdpa_sim, mlx5_vnet, caif_virtio): one copy()/slow_copy() into stack desc; rcheck clamps len from local copy (vringh.c:383-389); chained index bounds-checked (vringh.c:423-426). (5) drivers/vhost/net.c:738 vhost_net_build_xdp virtio_net_hdr csum_start/csum_offset check-then-fixup is the closest seed twin but operates on a kernel page_frag snapshot made by copy_page_from_iter (net.c:728-731) before both reads - post-fix pattern, not the bug. (6) vsock.c:359 payload_len read from skb-local hdr copy; check and copy_from_iter consume the same scalar. (7) scsi.c:901 header pulled once via copy_from_iter_full; all later uses consume vc->req. (8) vdpa_sim_blk.c:124 type/sector from stack hdr; validation and buffer accesses share locals. (9) vduse_dev.c:1096 SET_CONFIG offset/length validated and used from one copy_from_user snapshot. (10) vhost/vdpa.c:312 get/set_config use one local vhost_vdpa_config copy. (11) vhost net.c:613 TX/RX plumbing uses only kernel-local vq->iov translations. Limitations: drivers/virtio/virtio_ring.c and drivers/vdpa/{mlx5,ifcvf,alibaba,solidrun} control-vq handlers plus caif_virtio vringh user rings were located but not deeply read (unresolved); no compilation/dynamic reproducer was built - conclusion rests on line-level single-fetch dataflow tracing; s04's net/xdp/xsk.c contains no TX metadata offload code at all, so no seed-replica exists in this tree. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i015.json (version 1, execution_status complete, snapshots_checked exactly ["s04"], empty findings, 12 candidates, 4 limitations).
